title: Wintermute Wins 76% of Hyperliquid’s Early Data Auction in Crypto Trading Race
digest: Wintermute successfully won 76% of Hyperliquid’s early data access auction, enhancing its competitive edge in crypto derivatives trading (PANews, 2026-11-13). The auction mechanism allows traders to bid for priority access to real-time order data, which Hyperliquid confirmed in its Bloomberg Markets report (2026-11-12). However, DRW’s founder criticized the system’s fairness and regulatory compliance (PANews, 2026-11-13). Current disclosures do not address regulatory implications of preferential data access, though Hyperliquid confirmed the arrangement with Wintermute (Bloomberg Markets, 2026-11-12).
